newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: First National Namibia launches Euro-loan.
newsitem.headline: First National Namibia launches Euro-loan.

text.p: South Africa's First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Friday its Namibian unit, FNBN, had mandated Fuji Bank Ltd to arrange and underwrite its debut one-year, $30 million Euro-syndicated loan.
"It is...the first financing facility to be structured for a Namibian private sector borrower on the international syndicated loan market," FNBN managing director, Stuart Moir said in a statement
The loan, which is priced at LIBOR plus 50 basis points, would be for general corporate funding requirements Moir said.
Co-arrangers of the facility Banque National de Paris and ING Barings launched the loan on June 16.
Fuji Bank said it had received a positive initial response to the facility.
FNBN, which listed on the Namibian Stock Exchange in March, is the country's largest commercial bank.
